claimSubmitterIdentifier.description:
Identifier used to track a claim from creation by the health
care provider through payment (CLM01)

monetaryAmount.description: Monetary amount.  Total amount of all submitted charges of service segments for this claim. CLM02

healthCareServiceLocationInformation.description:
Identifies the place of service or the type of bill related to the
location at which a health care service was rendered

responseCodes.description: Code indicating a Yes or No condition or response

providerAcceptAssignmentCode.description: Code indicating whether the provider accepts assignment (CLM07)

releaseOfInformationCode.description:
Code indicating whether the provider has on file a signed statement by
the patient authorizing the release of medical data to other
organizations (CLM09)

patientSignatureSourceCode.description:
Code indicating how the patient or subscriber authorization signatures were obtained and
how they are being retained by the provider.

relatedCausesInformation.description: Identifies one or more related causes and associated state or country information.

delayReasonCode.description: Code indicating the reason why a request was delayed
